description: This PHP source file defines a class 'CustomFieldMenuConfigurator' that implements a menu configuration for the Human Resource Management system OrangeHRM. It sets up a menu override for custom fields within the PIM module.

classes.name: CustomFieldMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration to override or set up menu behavior for custom fields in the system.

methods.description: Overrides screen for current module to 'listCustomFields' and returns null.
